_doc: Allowlist for scripts/rulescheck.mjs. literals: file -> faction, zone or town names quoted outside src/data and src/world, with the reason in why. tables: table id -> row keys whose move or rename is a coordinated change in the same PR. layering: 'file -> imported file'. ciExempt: npm script names that need no ci.yml step (hashcheck runs as the hash-guard job). mapCaptures: 'file#name' -> reason. bareReads: file -> {n, why}, the reads of CRYPT or LAIR that stand behind a guard of their own (#1013).

why.src/sim/dmsight.js: dm_sight guild summary prints the two faction names by index (['Concord','Warband'][fac]); should read FAC[fac].name when sight is next touched
why.src/sim/levers.js: create_npc's faction param is a public enum of the DM tools ('concord'|'warband'|'neutral'), a vocabulary of the lever, not a lookup of the world; should derive from FAC when the lever is next touched
why.src/sim/staged.js: stage_scene casts pass the same create_npc faction enum through

mapCaptures.src/data/fauna.js#STOCK: the stock tables taken before any world rewrites them; a copy of the map's tables is the point of it
mapCaptures.src/data/races.js#RACES: a people's culture line names its first hall: the people's own past, written once, not the map on screen (#1013)
mapCaptures.src/sim/company.js#fightSeen: a member's fight in progress, cleared when it ends; a crossing opens only with no fight on
mapCaptures.src/sim/dm.js#lastRoll: the newest entry of the DM log, not a table of the map
mapCaptures.src/sim/brain.js#inflight: a hero's pending model call or line, by hero id: no map data
mapCaptures.src/sim/brain.js#sent: a hero's pending model call or line, by hero id: no map data
mapCaptures.src/sim/brain.js#asked: a hero's pending model call or line, by hero id: no map data
mapCaptures.src/sim/brain.js#lastSay: a hero's pending model call or line, by hero id: no map data
mapCaptures.src/sim/brain.js#ready: a hero's pending model call or line, by hero id: no map data
mapCaptures.src/sim/brain.js#held: a hero's pending model call or line, by hero id: no map data
mapCaptures.src/sim/company.js#lastState: each member's last state word, by hero id
mapCaptures.src/sim/dm.js#boardLever: the lever behind the hook being posted, for that one post
mapCaptures.src/sim/dmlog.js#pend: the DM log entry being written, for that one call

src/sim/save.js.why: the first dungeon's group and cooldown in the save, behind a test of CRYPT at both ends

src/sim/search.js.why: LANDMARKS.includes(CRYPT) behind CRYPT&&: a test, not a read

src/world/words.js.why: the world's words are built from the map itself, behind if(LAIR)

src/render/draw.js.why: the lair's embers and label, drawn only while S.boss.alive, which a map with no lair never is

src/render/memorials.js.why: the cooled lair, behind the lair landmark being found on this map

src/ui/panels.js.why: the View the raid button, behind if(LAIR)

src/ui/probe.js.why: a dev probe that writes the dungeon's group, behind if(!CRYPT) return

src/ui/table.js.why: the Table banner's way to the raid arena, behind &&LAIR

src/ui/timeline.js.why: the timeline's Inside link, behind &&LAIR and &&CRYPT
